name: EdgeDesk Simulator — NFL correlated season simulation
hypothesis: Simulating the remaining NFL season 100,000 times from the served game model (edgedesk_nfl_v2), with one persistent normal strength offset per club calibrated on 2006-2024 frozen forecasts, produces calibrated probabilities of playoff qualification, division titles, seeds, conference titles and the Super Bowl.
objective: Calibrated season-outcome probabilities (make playoffs, win division, seed 1, win conference, win Super Bowl) from any as-of week, as a research comparison against Kalshi futures prices; never a recommendation.
primary_metric: Brier score of win_division and make_playoffs probabilities on the holdout seasons at as-of weeks 4, 8, 12 and 16, pooled; then log loss with probabilities clipped to [max(1e-6, 0.5/N), 1 - that].
unit: One club-season-outcome at one as-of week (32 clubs x outcome x week x season); repeated snapshots of one season are NOT independent: every interval is a season-cluster bootstrap.
baseline: The same simulator with sigma = 0 (no strength uncertainty, the model's game probabilities only); and, where owned, same-time Kalshi futures reference prices (none owned historically).
training_window: Strength sigma calibrated on frozen-forecast residuals of 2006-2024 (simulator/data/nfl_strength_uncertainty.json); the game model is the served one, trained through 2025.
validation_window: 2010-2024 walk-forward replay (simulator/src/research/nfl_backtest.ts), descriptive only: sigma was calibrated on these seasons, so they cannot decide promotion.
holdout_window: Seasons 2025, 2026 and 2027, each evaluated once after its Super Bowl.

machine.window_note: [from, to): dates of the seasons inside each window

minimum_sample.note: Below three holdout seasons the record is reported descriptively and no result row is written. The market criteria need same-time Kalshi futures quotes EdgeDesk captured itself (sim_futures_quotes); none exist before 2026, so until enough are captured those criteria are NOT EVALUABLE and the model cannot pass.

promotion_criteria.decision_rule: passed = true only if every criterion below holds on the holdout. A criterion that cannot be evaluated is not met. Passing makes the model eligible; a person promotes it through a validation report. Software tests passing is never evidence for any criterion.

criteria.rule: Pooled Brier (win_division, make_playoffs; weeks 4/8/12/16; holdout seasons) of the production simulator <= the sigma = 0 simulator's, with the season-cluster bootstrap 95% upper bound of (production - sigma0) below +0.002.
Calibration slope of logit(p) on the pooled holdout outcomes within [0.8, 1.2] and every decile bin with n >= 30 within 0.08 of its observed rate.

Log loss below the same-time Kalshi reference (mid of a two-sided quote within 60 minutes of the run's input snapshot) on >= 200 matched outcomes, season-cluster bootstrap 95% CI of the difference below 0. Closing-market comparisons are reported separately and cannot satisfy this criterion.

Flagged opportunities (executable edge after verified fees) show a positive mean executable CLV against the observed close on >= 100 flags with observed closes; missing closes are counted as missing, never as a settled 0/1.

promotion_criteria.family_correction: All four are required (an intersection test); no criterion is reported as a pass on its own.

candidates_tried.strength: persistent normal offset per club, sigma by win-total calibration
candidates_tried.evaluated_against_outcomes: only through the sigma calibration (2006-2024 remaining-win variance), not through any season-outcome probability

alternatives_considered_not_tried: sigma from the within-club residual covariance alone (3.85 at week 7 vs the chosen 3.99; reported beside it)
a Gaussian copula preserving each game's exact model marginal
Elo-style in-season rating updates from simulated results (hot simulation)
forking_paths.choice_and_reason: The win-total calibration targets the season-level quantity directly and absorbs the served margin distribution's own width (the frozen-forecast consistency check showed that adding the covariance sigma on top of the served distribution would overstate per-game variance); the two estimators agree within their intervals.
forking_paths.data_already_seen: 2006-2025 NFL results and the 2026 season to week 7 (the simulator's first live inputs). No 2025-2027 season-outcome probability has been scored.
forking_paths.stopping_rule: Fixed horizon: each holdout season is evaluated once after its Super Bowl.

spec.engine: simulator/src/core (xoshiro128** 1.1 seeded by SplitMix64; per-run streams from (seed, run, stream))
spec.game_model: football/engine.js dist.coverProbSpread over the served nfl_params_v2 margin table, read at fair + d_home - d_away
spec.rules: simulator/src/sports/nfl/rules.ts NFL-TB-2020 (verified against 2002-2025 nflverse standings: every division rank and seed)
known_limitations: no injury return sampling; no new injuries
ratings frozen at the as-of date; within-season drift OFF
points-ranking tiebreaks use Estimated scores; net-touchdown tiebreaks have no model input (seeded coin toss, counted)
postseason rest and the Super Bowl site are Estimated inputs
the served game model does not beat the closing line
